body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, perceive from that point and learn when a detected creature within 2 units begins an Action or movement. This grants no extra Reaction.

surges.html: Increase the viewpoint's sensing radius by 1 unit.
Gain +1 to the targeted Defense against the next attack originating in that radius until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Projection
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, your next Psionics Reaction triggered by a creature in the watched area ignores ordinary concealment before your next turn.
